evidence.decision: Launch bounded paired longer training; promising temporal-geometry configuration, not scientific admission.
evidence.rationale: Both seeds strongly reduce freely generated temporal derivative errors. Choose the geometry-only arm to isolate this supported mechanism; added low-sigma coverage does not restore momentum amplitudes.
limitations: All physical and derivative audits still detect distribution differences; every original strict scorecard remains failed.
Early kinetic derivatives and spatial variation are underestimated; late kinetic spatial variation and high-frequency power remain excessive.
Momentum amplitudes remain too low, and cov_low further reduces them despite somewhat lower joint SW.
This is not proof that cov_base is the globally best configuration, nor that longer training will fix amplitude or distribution coverage.
evidence.summary_semantics: RMS is per-trajectory probe RMS then averaged across trajectories; reference is the mean of reference A/B means. No continuum norm or population quantile qualification.
